sentences.text: Candidodon is classified as a reptile.
The genus was described by Carvalho and Campos in 1988.
Fossils of this animal date to the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous, though it lived between 119.57 and 93.9 million years ago, spanning the Aptian to Cenomanian stages.
Remains have been found in the Early Cretaceous Itapecuru and Alcântara Formations in Brazil.
It is debated whether Mariliasuchus belongs to the family Comahuesuchidae; if so, Candidodon would be the sole member of the family Candidodontidae.
